name: Dr. Sonam Angmo Garg
headline: Eye Specialist in Dubai
lede: One of the Eye specialist in Dubai, Dr. Sonam Garg is dedicated to providing patient-centric eye care to achieve the best vision possible.
about: Dr. Sonam Angmo Garg is dedicated to providing comprehensive, advanced, and patient-centric eye care to help individuals achieve the best vision possible. With expertise in MICS Cataract Surgery, Retinal Lasers, Pterygium Surgery, Dry Eye Management, Intravitreal Injections, Ocular Trauma, and Comprehensive Eye Care, she utilizes the latest technologies and treatment approaches to ensure optimal eye health.

Micro-Incision Cataract Surgery (MICS) is an advanced technique that uses a tiny incision (less than 2.2 mm) to remove cataracts and implant an intraocular lens (IOL). This minimally invasive procedure.
